job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: November30,2022 at 4:30pm HST; issue date and RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: The document is an Oklahoma Teachers’ Retirement System investment consulting RFP issued in 2025, not the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: The Teachers’ Retirement System of Oklahoma (TRS) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide investment consultant services.
The deadline for receipt of completed proposals is 4:00 p.m. Central Time, on January 14, 2026.
